messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — found a tokenizer regression causing tokenization mismatch on long inputs. We should bump to v0.23.1 and patch changelog. Cutoff in ~90m. Who can own bump + cherry-pick? :eyes:

kai: I can take the bump. Will need a tiny changelog blurb and QA smoke run. Point me to changelog PR template.

maria: Thanks @kai. Changelog blurb suggestion:
```
v0.23.1
- Fix: tokenizer off-by-one on long sequences (regression)
- Test: added smoke for long prompt tokenization
```

sam: I can do the cherry-pick and open PR to release branch. ETA ~20m.

rachel: QA: QA team will run smoke suite once PR lands. Assign to @qa-lead for gating.

qa-lead: assigning smoke to @sam's PR, will run full smoke + fuzz on tokenization. If green, we can cut. Target confirmation in ~40m.

security-team: quick FYI: no sensitive surface here but will do a fast dependency check on the cherry-pick. ping if you touch parsing libs.

deploy-bot: CI triggered for sam/pr-1234 — running unit tests and smoke. Status: queued.

kai: Also need docs tweak — add note in tokens.md about improved handling. @rachel can you do a one-liner?

rachel: Yep I'll add doc line and push to the docs PR after cut. Quick note ready: "Tokenizer edge-case fixed for long inputs."

maria: Rollout plan: if QA green, we cut branch, tag v0.23.1, run canary with 5% traffic for 15m, then roll to 100% if no regressions. If any failures, fallback to v0.23.0 and open rollback runbook.

sam: PR is up: https://git.redwood.ai/pr/1234 — cherry-pick + bump. CI passed unit tests, smoke running.

deploy-bot: Smoke results: 2/3 flaky tests failing (tokenization-fuzz intermittent). Marking as flaky, re-running.

qa-lead: Observed one flaky seed. Re-running full smoke now. ETA ~12m. If flakes persist we might delay cutoff by 30m.

maria: If delay needed, notify stakeholders ASAP. @kai prepare patch notes regardless. :thumbsup:

sam: smoke passed on re-run. QA green. Ready for tag.

rachel: docs updated in #docs PR 567. One-liner added.

maria: OK tagging v0.23.1 now and starting canary. :shipit: 

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2024-04-17T10:04:20Z — 5% traffic. Monitor: rolling.

maria: Thanks team — will post release notes and changelog after canary completes. Closing this thread once 100% rollout done. :party:
